title: Manufacturer Audit Debits of Paid Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage Claims
content:
# Manufacturer Audit Debits of Paid Claims

**Standard.** Under the Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage, the manufacturer may debit a paid claim found on audit to be unsupported (not covered, outside the term, or performed without the required documentation) within the coverage type's audit debit window of calendar days after its payment; a claim is debited at most once and only in full. A debit never becomes a charge to the customer for work the store performed as covered.

**Record of a debit.** A debit is recorded against the paid claim it takes back, with the debit date, the claim type of that paid claim, the amount debited and the reason found on audit. The debit reduces the amount paid under the coverage. Whether a paid claim has already been debited is read from the company's claim records before a debit is recorded.

## The standard restated

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Who may debit | the manufacturer |
| What may be debited | a paid claim found on audit to be unsupported |
| Unsupported means | not covered, outside the term, or performed without the required documentation |
| Time allowed | within the audit debit window, in calendar days after payment |
| How often | at most once per paid claim |
| How much | only in full |
| Effect on the customer | none for work the store performed as covered |

## Hypothetical cases

- A paid claim of 240.00 is found on audit to have been outside the term. It may be debited once, for the full 240.00, and the amount paid under the coverage falls by 240.00; the customer is not charged for the work.
- A paid claim that has already been debited once is not debited again.
